scope: Actual full Gaia-CRF3 l1+l2 observable VSH, conditional on published astrometry and working covariance
sky_support_status: Complete public CRF3 membership; retained source directions conditioned exact
null_mock_status: NOT_AVAILABLE: no empirical joint sky/frame/calibration null
allowed_use: Catalogue observable coefficients, frame quotient and conditional sensitivity only

job.query: SELECT g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.pmra,g.pmdec,g.pmra_error,g.pmdec_error,g.pmra_pmdec_corr,g.ra_pmra_corr,g.ra_pmdec_corr,g.dec_pmra_corr,g.dec_pmdec_corr,g.parallax,g.parallax_error,g.astrometric_params_solved,g.ruwe FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_crf3_xm AS q ON g.source_id=q.source_id

source_id.description: Unique source identifier (unique within a particular Data Release)

pmra.description: Proper motion in right ascension direction

pmra_error.description: Standard error of proper motion in right ascension direction

pmdec_error.description: Standard error of proper motion in declination direction

pmra_pmdec_corr.description: Correlation between proper motion in right ascension and proper motion in declination

ra_pmra_corr.description: Correlation between right ascension and proper motion in right ascension

ra_pmdec_corr.description: Correlation between right ascension and proper motion in declination

dec_pmra_corr.description: Correlation between declination and proper motion in right ascension

dec_pmdec_corr.description: Correlation between declination and proper motion in declination

astrometric_params_solved.description: Which parameters have been solved for?

job.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_crf3_xm AS q ON g.source_id=q.source_id

considered_for_reference_frame_orientati.description: Considered for the reference frame orientation

considered_for_reference_frame_spin.description: Considered for the reference frame spin

used_for_reference_frame_orientation.description: Used for the reference frame orientation

used_for_reference_frame_spin.description: Used for the reference frame spin

retention.rule: Finite unmasked RA/Dec, both pm and positive errors, abs(correlation)<1; no proper-motion cut or RUWE cut
retention.upstream_selection: CRF3 itself was astrometrically filtered, including proper motions; results are conditioned on that released selection, not an unbiased unselected QSO population

covariance.spatial: NOT_PROVIDED: working fits do not assert cross-source independence as an empirical fact

convention.coordinates: ICRS RA,DEC in degrees, reference epoch J2016.0 (TCB)
convention.normalization: Cartesian dipole and Frobenius-orthonormal STF matrix coordinates; not normalized scalar-Ylm coefficients/powers

frame_projected.reason: Arbitrary frame spin is exactly degenerate with all three B1 columns

frame_subset.independence: Not independent: common attitude/calibration and source/frame selection; Gaia DR3 and EDR3 astrometry are identical observations

spatial_sensitivity.partition: 12 equal-area cells: 4 RA quadrants x 3 equal sin(dec) bins
spatial_sensitivity.method: Whole-source angular holdout; no splitting pm components or resampling duplicated observations
spatial_sensitivity.caveat: Coarse partition sensitivity only; not a fitted spatial correlation kernel, independent null simulation, or coverage guarantee

radio_crosswalk.interpretation: Crosswalk is positional compatibility, not proof of independent radio/optical errors; radio epoch and optical structure can alter offsets

radio.convention_status: CDS ReadMe does not explicitly distinguish coordinate rate from tangent component; both sensitivity branches retained
